sections.name: File setup (part 1)
sections.title: Root wrapper, backdrop, and sliding panel
sections.what: Sets the drawer root with the background scaling effect on by default. Builds the dim backdrop and the bottom panel with its rounded top corners and grab bar.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives the drawer its slide-up look and a visual handle users can see.

summary: Builds a bottom sheet (drawer) that slides up from the bottom of the screen, with a backdrop, a grab bar, a header, a footer, a title, and a description.
purpose: Provides a slide-up panel, often used on phones, with the same look as the rest of the app.
why: Likely reason: a slide-up panel is a common mobile pattern, so this wraps a dedicated drawer library. The code does not state the exact reason.
how: It imports the drawer library and style helper. The root wrapper turns on a background scaling effect by default. It then wraps the backdrop and the sliding panel, adds a small grab bar at the top, and builds header, footer, title, and description parts. Everything is exported at the end.
inputs: Open state set by the screen, content placed inside the panel, optional style overrides, and standard element settings.
outputs: A slide-up panel component. Nothing is stored.
risks: The background scaling effect changes the page behind the panel. Turning it off or on affects the look of every drawer that uses this root wrapper.
debug: If the drawer does not open, check the screen that controls it. If it slides in the wrong place, check the panel style in this file. If the background does not scale, check the root wrapper setting.
